note: Every use CVCOPs could serve, in one register. docs/OPPORTUNITIES.md explains it; tests/unit/test_opportunities.py keeps it well formed and tied to the capability manifest. Zones are judgment, not measurement. Nothing here enters a mission until its rows are in the blueprint's threshold table and locked (decision 0003).

items.title: Temporal check
items.evidence: evidence/opportunities_reference.py, temporal: planted frames score 2.52 and 9.96 against a median of 0.66
items.first_step: Draw rows from fresh sequences (a pop, a flicker, a hard cut that must not rank), add them to the threshold table, lock, then write src/cvcops/ops/temporal.py.

items.title: Carry a fix across frames
items.evidence: Mission 4's warp row; evidence/opportunities_reference.py, carry: the mark moved (21.98, 8.98) px for a (22, 9) px motion
items.first_step: Mission 4's example pulls a later frame onto an earlier one with the forward flow, so v0.1 carries a fix toward earlier frames. Carrying toward later frames needs the backward layer.

items.title: Generative-video check
items.first_step: Run the temporal check on one generated clip and one filmed clip of similar motion, and compare the score curves.

items.title: Denoiser boil check
items.first_step: Run the temporal check on a denoised sequence and on its noisy source; the extra residual is what the denoiser added.

items.title: See motion on unrendered footage
items.first_step: Mission 3's example scene feeds the flow layer to Visualize Velocity.

items.title: Particles from motion
items.evidence: evidence/opportunities_reference.py, emit: 767 of 9,000 seeds kept, 99.9% of them on the moving disc. The pairing with SOPs is untested.
items.first_step: After Mission 3, read the flow layer in SOPs, or through MotionCOPs' Point Advect by Layer, and emit where the motion exceeds a threshold.

items.title: Backward flow as a layer
items.evidence: the worker computes it for validity (blueprint, section 12, item 2)
items.first_step: Write it as a second file beside flow.####.exr, add a row that checks it against the reversed pair, and expose the planned backward output.

items.title: Stillest frame of a burst
items.first_step: Median flow magnitude inside the subject for each neighbouring pair of a burst; the lowest wins. No Houdini needed.

items.title: Motion matte
items.evidence: OpenCV ships MOG2 and KNN background models (FACTS C3); untested here
items.first_step: A new operation with its own contract: locked-off footage in, a Mono matte out.

items.title: Feature tracks into SOPs
items.evidence: OpenCV ships sparse Lucas-Kanade (FACTS C3); untested here
items.first_step: A new operation: points with ids per frame, delivered as geometry.

items.title: Stabilise and match
items.evidence: OpenCV ships multi-scale ECC (FACTS C3); untested here
items.first_step: A new operation: transform parameters per frame, applied by a native transform.

items.title: Relight that holds still
items.first_step: The temporal check on a relit sequence against the plate it came from.

items.title: Motion as a guide for video models
items.evidence: untested; depends on what each model accepts
items.first_step: Pick one model that takes motion guidance and find out the format it wants.

items.title: Receipts on the USD stage
items.first_step: A writer from receipts to a small USD layer, so a stage knows which frames carry trusted motion.

items.title: Vector motion blur
items.evidence: untested; Copernicus ships no motion-blur node (FACTS H2)
items.first_step: A blur pass along the flow layer, as an OpenCL COP.

items.title: In-betweens for a retime
items.evidence: untested; native Time Blend covers plain blends (FACTS H3)
items.first_step: A two-sided warp from both neighbours, mixed by validity.

items.evidence: untested; needs a hook into the renderer
